Name: Cuter Fatter Dinos
Author: Identitypollution
Description:
This mod replaces the ugly default dinosaur with this good chonky girl.

To Install:
1. OPTIONAL (but suggested just incase): Backup your baby dinosur.xnb file located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download and extract download.
3. Put the new .xnb files where your old ones were (at the location above). Make sure to REPLACE the files or your game won't know what to use and won't start.
4. Done! Launch the game and enjoy her wobbles~!
